summary: Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to disclose its Q1 2026 financial results and provide a non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA reconciliation. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is involved. The press release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, contains standard operational updates. This is an ordinary current report with no event-driven corporate action; therefore it does not fit any special-situation category.
